name: Marisol Esperanza Vega Castellanos
extra_bullets: Set up a simple weekly sales and labor report in Google Sheets that the district now uses for all six stores
Ran the store's year-end inventory count, including planning, staffing and reconciling the final numbers
cover_letter_paragraph: Retail also taught me to work with people under pressure. During the holidays I'm scheduling 40 people, answering customers and still closing the week's numbers on Sunday night. I've learned to keep things simple, write things down, and ask for help early, and I'd bring the same habits to an analytics team.
